pack.name: Gas Station
pack.blurb: Loud little prints from the spinning rack by the register.

heroes.name: Tacos With Faces
heroes.flavor: Each one is having a slightly different day.

heroes.name: Dinosaur on a Lawnmower
heroes.flavor: The lawn has never looked better, and nobody knows whose lawn it is.

heroes.name: Bass in Sunglasses
heroes.flavor: Got thrown back once and has worn these ever since.

heroes.name: Hot Dog Astronaut
heroes.flavor: The first hot dog in orbit, and it is still a little warm.

heroes.name: Cactus Wearing a Hat
heroes.flavor: Keeps the hat on indoors, and nobody has had the heart to mention it.

heroes.name: Raccoon Eating Fries
heroes.flavor: Insists the fries were a gift.

heroes.name: Pickle Party
heroes.flavor: Nobody remembers who invited the pickles, but the party got better.

heroes.name: UFO Abducting a Cow
heroes.flavor: The cow seems oddly calm about the whole thing.

heroes.name: The Flamingo
heroes.flavor: Has been standing on one leg since the store opened.

heroes.name: A Sloth Doing Taxes
heroes.flavor: Filed on time, which surprised everyone, including the sloth.
